documentation.short: No security advisory stays in triage or draft for more than 90 days. Published advisories record their days to publication.
documentation.fix: Project team with the OSPO: finish the triage and publish the advisory with a CVE, or close it as not a vulnerability.

documentation.short: The README of the archived repository names a successor or an alternative.
documentation.fix: While the notice issue is open, add a successor or alternative to the README. Once archived, the repository is read-only, so ask the OSPO to unarchive it briefly.

documentation.short: The repository was archived only after a public notice issue had been open for the grace period (60 days).
documentation.fix: Ask the OSPO to unarchive the repository and let it go through the notice process, or to record an accepted exception in config/compliance_report.yaml.

documentation.short: create_repos --dry-run plans no changes: actual access on GitHub matches the approved configuration.
documentation.fix: OSPO: either run the create_repos workflow to revert the manual change on GitHub, or approve the change by updating config/create_repos.yaml through a pull request.

documentation.short: No dependency in the SBOM uses a license on the deny list.
documentation.fix: Replace the listed dependencies with alternatives under an allowed license, or ask the OSPO for an exception.

documentation.short: A file CONTRIBUTING* exists in ., .github or docs.
documentation.fix: Add CONTRIBUTING.md to .github/ describing how to propose changes and what is expected of a contribution.

documentation.short: The development guide has a "Build" heading. Not applicable to repositories tagged docs or template.
documentation.fix: Add a "Build" heading to DEVELOPMENT.md that explains how to build the project.

documentation.short: A file DEVELOPMENT* exists in ., docs or .github, with at least 300 characters. Not applicable to repositories tagged docs or template.
documentation.fix: Add DEVELOPMENT.md (root, docs or .github) with at least 300 characters on how to build and test the project.

documentation.short: The development guide has a "Test" heading. Not applicable to repositories tagged docs or template.
documentation.fix: Add a "Test" heading to DEVELOPMENT.md that explains how to run the tests.

documentation.short: Issues are enabled, so defects can be reported.
documentation.fix: Enable Issues under Settings > General > Features.

documentation.short: A file LICENSE* exists in the repository root.
documentation.fix: Add a LICENSE file with the approved license text to the repository root.

documentation.short: The license GitHub detects is on the approved list. A missing or unidentified license (NOASSERTION) fails.
documentation.fix: Use an approved license (Apache-2.0, MIT, CC-BY-4.0, CC0-1.0) and make sure the LICENSE text is unmodified so GitHub can detect it.

documentation.short: Repositories with more than 5% code in a non-memory-safe language (C, C++, Objective-C, assembly) have a "Memory safety" heading in the development guide.
documentation.fix: Add a "Memory safety" heading to DEVELOPMENT.md describing fuzzing, sanitizers or other measures.

documentation.short: No user has direct access to the repository; access is granted to teams only.
documentation.fix: Remove the direct collaborators and grant access through a team in config/create_repos.yaml via pull request.

documentation.short: For repositories with security: custom, private vulnerability reporting is enabled. Other repositories are covered by the org security configuration.
documentation.fix: Enable private vulnerability reporting under Settings > Code security, or switch the repository to the managed security configuration.

documentation.short: The repository is public.
documentation.fix: Ask the OSPO to review the repository; visibility is changed centrally, not by the project team.

documentation.short: Every release of the last 12 months has release notes of at least 50 characters, or the CHANGELOG mentions the version.
documentation.fix: Add release notes (at least 50 characters) to each GitHub release, or mention the version in CHANGELOG.md.

documentation.short: For repositories with security: custom, secret scanning and push protection are enabled. Other repositories are covered by the org security configuration.
documentation.fix: Enable secret scanning and push protection under Settings > Code security, or switch the repository to the managed security configuration.

documentation.short: Every release of the last 12 months has a SemVer or CalVer tag, and versions increase with release date within each major line.
documentation.fix: Tag releases with SemVer or CalVer and make sure versions increase with release date within each major line.

documentation.short: The base permission for members is none, so access is granted through teams only.
documentation.fix: OSPO: set the base permission back to none in the organisation settings, or change the expected value in config/org_check.yaml through a pull request.

documentation.short: The ospo-managed security configuration is enforced and enables code scanning (CodeQL default setup).
documentation.fix: OSPO: restore code scanning in the ospo-managed security configuration, or change the expected value in config/org_check.yaml through a pull request.

documentation.short: The ospo-managed security configuration is enforced and enables the dependency graph.
documentation.fix: OSPO: restore the dependency graph in the ospo-managed security configuration, or change the expected value in config/org_check.yaml through a pull request.

documentation.short: The ospo-managed security configuration is enforced and enables private vulnerability reporting.
documentation.fix: OSPO: restore private vulnerability reporting in the ospo-managed security configuration, or change the expected value in config/org_check.yaml through a pull request.

documentation.short: Members cannot create repositories; repositories are created only by the provisioning pipeline.
documentation.fix: OSPO: switch off repository creation for members in the organisation settings, or change the expected value in config/org_check.yaml through a pull request.

documentation.short: The ospo-managed ruleset requires at least 1 approving review before merging.
documentation.fix: OSPO: restore the required approvals in the ospo-managed ruleset, or change the expected value in config/org_check.yaml through a pull request.

documentation.short: The ospo-managed ruleset is active on default branches: pull request required, no force push, no deletion.
documentation.fix: OSPO: restore the ospo-managed ruleset, or change the expected value in config/org_check.yaml through a pull request.

documentation.short: The ospo-managed security configuration is enforced and enables secret scanning and push protection.
documentation.fix: OSPO: restore secret scanning and push protection in the ospo-managed security configuration, or change the expected value in config/org_check.yaml through a pull request.

documentation.short: The org default allianz/.github/SECURITY.md exists and names a security contact.
documentation.fix: OSPO: restore allianz/.github/SECURITY.md with a security contact.

documentation.short: Two-factor authentication is required for all members of the organisation.
documentation.fix: OSPO: require two-factor authentication again in the organisation settings, or change the expected value in config/org_check.yaml through a pull request.

documentation.short: The dependency graph SBOM can be retrieved for the default branch.
documentation.fix: Make sure the dependency graph is enabled (Settings > Code security, or switch to the managed security configuration) and dependencies are declared in a supported manifest or lock file.

documentation.short: At most 5% of the packages in the SBOM have no license information (NOASSERTION).
documentation.fix: Where possible, upgrade or replace packages without license information; ask the OSPO if the package is needed and its license is known.
